name: sheetyapp
description: SheetyApp — read and change workbooks (sheets, columns, rows, queries, apps and widgets, row-actions, procedures, timing actions, webhooks, fields, API templates, q-functions) and validate Q-Expressions through the shp CLI.

settings.label: API URL
settings.description: The SheetyApp API the CLI talks to. Change it only for a non-production environment. It is applied at sign-in: after changing it the plugin reads as signed out until you Authenticate again, so commands never run against one environment with a login from another.

settings.label: Identity provider URL
settings.description: The SheetyApp identity provider used for the device-code sign-in. Must belong to the same environment as the API URL.

settings.label: Web app URL
settings.description: Base URL of the SheetyApp web app. Not used by the CLI — the agent builds page links for users from it, and reads it as $SHEETYAPP_WEB_URL.

settings.label: CLI download URL
settings.description: Where install.sh downloads the shp binary from: <this URL>/<platform>/shp, e.g. linux-x64. Change it only to install a CLI build from somewhere else.
